subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Space and Satellite Risk
description: A 60-second lesson on Space and Satellite Risk.

hook.text: GPS goes down globally. Planes can't navigate. Ships are lost. ATMs fail. Modern civilization depends on 31 satellites.

buildup.text: Space infrastructure — GPS, communications, weather satellites — underpins nearly every modern business operation.

discovery.text: A major solar storm like the 1859 Carrington Event could disable satellites and knock out power grids worldwide.

twist.text: Space debris threatens satellites. With 10,000+ objects in orbit, a collision cascade could make space unusable.

climax.text: Space is invisible infrastructure. We don't think about it until it fails, and when it fails, everything stops.

punchline.text: 31 satellites. GPS for the world. One solar storm ends it.

quiz.question: What could a Carrington-level solar storm do to modern infrastructure?
options: Disable satellites and knock out power grids worldwide
